description: The plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 4 with a tick label interval of 1. Three lines are depicted in the plot: the blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate", the orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate", and the green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline". The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, increases to around 1.5 at layer 10, and then rises sharply to about 4.5 at layer 18 before reaching its highest point. The orange dotted line and the green solid line both begin at approximately 0.1 at layer 0 and steadily increase to around 1.5 at layer 20, with the orange dotted line almost entirely overlapping the green solid line.
